# Highlight.js 11.12.0

Local browser build with common languages, including TypeScript. No package manager or runtime network request is needed.

- Bundle: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/highlight.js/11.12.0/highlight.min.js
- License: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/highlightjs/highlight.js/11.12.0/LICENSE
- Usage: https://highlightjs.org/#usage

Load the bundle with `defer`, then `../../highlight.js` (adjust paths for the HTML file). Link `assets/highlight.css` after `assets/course.css`. Mark code blocks with `class="language-typescript"`; use the appropriate language for other examples.
